title: AI-Gen-AI-Coding
summary: A personal collection of Gen AI coding exercises and tutorials, including an 'sdv-mcp' MCP server subproject whose stated purpose is to use SDV for synthetic data operations. That subproject imports sdv.metadata.Metadata and sdv.multi_table.HMASynthesizer, fitting and sampling a relational synthesizer and calling evaluate_quality, so SDV's HMA synthesizer and quality report API are directly run.
needs: The sdv-mcp folder appears copied from an 'ai-engineering-hub' example project rather than original work by this repo's owner; unclear how central it is to the overall personal learning repo.
